mapper.insert: INSERT INTO target_product_judgement (mydata_trade_id, ci_hash, stock_type, fund_code, fund_name, ticker, is_target, foreign_stock_ratio, inception_date, judged_at, trade_type, amount, trade_date, net_buy_amount) VALUES (#{mydataTradeId}, #{ciHash}, #{stockType}, #{fundCode}, #{fundName}, #{ticker}, #{isTarget}, #{foreignStockRatio}, #{inceptionDate}, #{judgedAt}, #{tradeType}, #{amount}, #{tradeDate}, #{netBuyAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT j.judgement_id AS judgementId, c.name AS customerName, j.stock_type AS stockType, j.fund_name AS fundName, j.ticker AS ticker, j.is_target AS isTarget, j.trade_type AS tradeType, j.amount AS amount, j.net_buy_amount AS netBuyAmount, j.trade_date AS tradeDate, j.judged_at AS judgedAt FROM target_product_judgement j JOIN customer c ON c.ci_hash = j.ci_hash ORDER BY j.judged_at DESC
